name: 端到端：F88 局部修改(AI编辑) → 确认 → URL一致性校验
description: 进入图片审核详情，勾选素材→hover主图触发工具栏→点击edit图标打开局部修改面板→填写prompt→确定→验证编辑前/后切换及URL从llm/变为localUpload/→点击确认完成审核→自动流转下一任务。实际UI: edit图标打开的是AI局部修改面板(prompt输入)，非画板涂抹编辑器。

steps.description: [造数] 自动创建待审核首图审核任务（数据自愈，解决无待审核数据阻塞）

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tr[data-row-key]')); const row = rows[0]; return row ? { taskId: row.getAttribute('data-row-key') } : null; })()

steps.description: 打开第一条待审核任务

steps.expression: (() => { const imgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img')).filter(i => i.src && i.src.includes('scene-ossgw') && i.getBoundingClientRect().width > 100); const materialImg = imgs.find(i => i.src.includes('/llm/')); return materialImg ? { originUrl: materialImg.src.substring(0, 120) } : null; })()
(() => { const cb = document.querySelector('[class*=MaterialSlider] input[type=checkbox]'); if(cb && !cb.checked) cb.click(); return 'checked'; })()

(async () => { await page.mouse.move(900, 350); await page.waitForTimeout(1000); const editIcon = await page.locator('[aria-label="edit"]').last(); const box = await editIcon.boundingBox(); if(box) { await page.mouse.click(box.x+box.width/2, box.y+box.height/2); return 'clicked edit'; } return 'not found'; })()
steps.description: hover主图→点击edit图标打开局部修改面板

steps.expression: (() => { const ta = document.querySelector('textarea[placeholder*="prompt"], textarea[placeholder*="修改"]'); if(!ta) return 'no textarea'; const nativeSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; nativeSetter.call(ta, '测试AI局部修改'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); return 'filled'; })()
(() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => /确\s*定/.test(b.textContent) && !b.disabled); if(btn){btn.click();return 'clicked';} return 'no btn'; })()
steps.description: 点击确定提交局部修改

steps.expression: (() => { const radios = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role=radio], input[type=radio]')); const labels = radios.map(r => ({label: r.parentElement?.textContent?.trim()?.substring(0,10), checked: r.checked || r.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='true'})); const editedImg = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img')).find(i => i.src && i.src.includes('/localUpload/')); return { hasToggle: radios.length >= 2, labels, editedUrl: editedImg ? editedImg.src.substring(0, 120) : null }; })()
steps.description: 验证编辑前/后切换及编辑后URL(localUpload路径)
断言编辑前/后切换存在

steps.expression: (() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => /确\s*认/.test(b.textContent) && b.className && b.className.includes('primary')); if(btn){btn.click();return 'clicked confirm';} return 'no btn'; })()
steps.description: 点击顶部工具栏'确认'按钮完成审核
等待自动流转下一任务
API断言审核状态为已通过

steps.sql: SELECT id, url, local_adjust_url, status FROM material WHERE task_id = '${store.firstTask.taskId}' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在待审核图片任务；素材图URL包含/llm/路径。
_testDesign.realDomNotes: edit图标(aria-label=edit)打开局部修改AI面板(prompt输入)→确定→编辑前/后Radio切换→确认→自动流转下一任务。URL从llm/变为localUpload/。
riskPoints: 无待审核任务时无法进入详情
局部修改prompt需等待AI处理完成
DB表名/字段需按真实schema调整
